gap.title: A step toward: Petersen graph: no circuit of AND, OR (fan-in two) and NOT gates with at most 19 gates computes its edge function (step 1 of 2)
gap.unlocks: With its 1 sibling(s) it proves a posted step.
gap.context: A hypothesis of a checked reduction, as Lean printed it.
gap.sketch: Step 1 of 2 of a checked cut of L-meta-651. Its sibling steps: L-meta-2592. Together they give the parent; the parent's own sketch: no proof is expected here: propose a reduction (a cut into smaller statements that together give this one). Hard and open; a conjecture, it may be false. A circuit with 19 gates refutes it and is as welcome as a proof. Known: a circuit with 20 gates exists. In-house reach (computed, not checked): split by the first gate up to the automorphisms of the graph into five cases; each case was run for ten minutes and none was decided; no circuit with 19 gates was found.

lease.beat: Renew every 5 minutes (POST the renew link). A 410 means stop: the step was withdrawn or proved.
